audit_items.proof_trace: Peers are not penalized for requests at FULU_FORK_EPOCH. The validation logic returns nil (no error) for pre-fork requests (L198-199) and sets minStartSlot=FULU_FORK_EPOCH at transition (L170-175). Penalization only occurs when validation returns an error (L66-70), which does not happen for legitimate fork-epoch requests.
